remarks: Welcome to 16 Grace Street - a truly special find! Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac within walking distance to all three in-town schools-South, NCMS, and NCHS-this charming 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial is located in one of New Canaan's most sought-after neighborhoods. Owned by the same family for 80 years, the home is brimming with timeless character and offers incredible potential. Whether you're looking to restore and customize to your personal style or build new on premium, level property, the possibilities are endless. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a property that combines classic charm, a prime location, and exceptional potential.
